Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, did you hear？
...Hmm？
Apparently, a new family restaurant is opening near Dixie's soon.
Huh, a family restaurant？ Wonder what place.
It's an American chain that just expanded to Japan recently, I hear. I think it's called Aisha Dining.
Huh, no kidding.
'Huh, no kidding' ...Wait, aren't you worried at all？
Not really, no... If anything, fewer customers might make work easier! Just kidding.
Geez, take it seriously.
(She got mad at me...)
(Alright, time to get to work!)
Manager
Hah...
Boss, what's wrong？
Oh, nothing, just... *sigh* Must be nice being a student part-timer with no worries...
Uh, yeah, sure...
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Isn't it kinda slow today？
Anegasaki
Well, you know, today's the grand opening for that new family restaurant.
Ah, that's why the boss was so gloomy. It was... Something Dining, right？
Aisha Dining. Looks like they really stole all our customers away today.
I see. So I guess business is booming over there.
I'm sure it is...
Hey, want to check it out after work？
Oho, scouting out the enemy, huh？
Not really, but... Well, maybe. I just can't help being curious.
Yeah. I'm curious what kind of place it is too, ●, so let's go!
So this is the place. Huh...
Anegasaki
It really is packed...
Come on, let's head in.
You look pretty excited. They're our rivals, you know？
'Rivals' is exaggerating. Besides, going somewhere new is always exciting.
Geez...
Clerk
Welcome.
Sure is lively in here.
It's lively, sure, but... it's a bit too noisy. I prefer a calmer atmosphere myself.
Yeah... but it definitely feels like an American chain.
Yeah. They just opened, and the staff is already really well-trained.
You can tell that？
Can't you tell？ I do the exact same job, after all.
Hahaha... Uh, come on, let's order.
...There's quite a lot on the menu. Hmm...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really looks like she came here on a recon mission.)
Cheap, huge portions... No wonder it's popular. Tastes pretty good, too.
Yeah, really. Just like an American chain. Still, at this rate...
Manager
Wait, what？ You two are here, too？
Manager.
You're here too, Manager？
Y-Yeah... something like that.
You're acting pretty suspicious, you know.
I mean, I *am* the manager of a rival store, after all...
You're just a customer right now, so you should act confident, though.
R-Really？
Oh, aren't you the manager of Dixie's？
Eep!
Eh？
U-Um... I, er...
Um, and you are...？
Pardon me, where are my manners.
Yarisawa
I am the manager of this Aisha Dining, Shin-Towano branch. My name is Yarisawa.
What!? The manager？
Indeed... Is there an issue？
N-No...
To think Dixie's manager would pay us a visit. How are you finding our establishment？
T-That's...
Come on, Manager!
R-Right... Um, what did you think, Nene-kun？
Me？
My, and you are...？
I'm a part-timer at Dixie's—
You're Anegasaki-san, aren't you？ Yes, I know of you.
...Even about me.
Of course. So？ What did you think of our restaurant？
Well... The interior is clean and bright, and you seem to have plenty of staff. Even though it's packed, we barely had to wait, so it was comfortable. However...
But？
Just a few minor things. The menu is huge, but that makes it harder to choose. As for the taste and presentation... it feels like the staff isn't fully used to things yet...
Mm, pretty harsh...
Um... I'm sorry.
Not at all. Your points were spot-on. Thank you for the valuable feedback.
As fellow rivals, here's to a long relationship together.
Rivals...
Though 'long' might be the wrong word... For our sake, we ought to make it as brief as possible, right？ Hehe.
As brief as... Wait! So you really are trying to put us out of business—
Good day to you, then.
Aisha Dining... Manager Yarisawa...
N-Nene-kun, what do we do？ Ow-ow-ow, my stomach again...
(A rival store, huh. If it's just based on our managers, I don't feel like we have a chance...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
What？
That Aisha Dining manager was really something else, wasn't she.
...Yeah, let's.
A far cry from our manager. She had that real go-getter vibe to her.
I wonder if our restaurant is gonna be okay...
I'm sure it'll be fine. We've lost customers, sure, but it won't go under so fast.
...Do you really think so？ We're actually in pretty serious trouble, you know？
Really？ You know that much about it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Well... I shouldn't really know this, but the manager and regular staff vent to me.
Hmm, I see... Maybe I should look for another job while I still can？
...What's that supposed to mean？ What do you mean？
I mean... even if this place goes under, I still need to work...
Well, yes, but... this place is—
It's where we met... It's full of our memories.
Ah...
So please don't talk like that.
You're right, I'm sorry...
Yes...
（The place full of memories for ● and me might disappear, huh...）
（All right, time for another day of work!）
Manager
Hah...
（I wish he'd stop. He's bringing my mood down too...）
（So dead... There's only one old guy here. Is this place really gonna be okay？）
Komari
It's been so slow lately. I wonder why？
Otori
Yeah... Aisha Dining opened, so maybe they're taking all our customers？
Oh, right! Nocchi, you're so smart~
（Even Komari-san and Otori-san...）
（Hm？ Why is that old man looking around so much？）
Excuse me, sir. Is everything alright？
Old Man
Oh, no, it's nothing...
...Excuse me, are those girls new part-timers？
...No, not really. I'm terribly sorry about the noise, sir.
No, no, not at all...
Here's your hot coffee. Thank you for waiting.
Thank you—
Ah! Oh no!
Okay...
Ah, I messed up... I'm so sorry!
No, no, it's quite alright.
Hey, Mayuko-kun!
Ugh, y-yes sir...
I need you to pull it together, especially in tough times like this!
I'm sorry...
Anegasaki
Manager, the customers can hear you. Please stop.
Ah, r-right... Sorry.
Mayu-chan, I'll help. Let's clean this up right away.
Yes...
Want me to help too, ●？
We'll be fine. Could you take Table 7？ They're waiting to order.
Understood.
Excuse me, sir, I am so sorry! Did anything get on your clothes？
Oh, don't worry, I'm fine.
We'll have this cleaned up right away.
Thanks for being so polite earlier, young lady.
Not at all, and I'm very sorry for the commotion.
No, no, it's fine. Well, thanks for the meal.
Thank you very much! We hope to see you again soon.
Good work.
What's wrong？
Yeah... It might just be my imagination, but didn't it seem like that older man was observing the store？
Yeah... Come to think of it, he was asking about the staff. That was kind of strange.
I knew it. Plus, I feel like I've seen him somewhere before...
Like a regular？
Hmm, not that. More like... maybe in a photo or something.
(I'm worried...)
(Alright, time to get to work!)
Manager
Oh, there you are. Perfect timing.
Oh, Manager. What's up？
I need to talk to everyone today, so please stick around after your shift.
A talk？ Uh, sure, I guess.
*Sigh*... My stomach hurts...
(This can't be good...)
'Sup~
Otori
Here we go.
Komari
Ah, you're here. ...Is this everyone on shift right now？
Anegasaki
Yes, that's all of us.
*Sigh*... So, what I need to talk about is this store...
Are we going out of business？ That'd really suck for me~
Mayu, come on...
I mean, ever since Aisha opened, we get like zero customers~
Um, Manager, so what happened？
Y-Yeah. It's just like Mayuko said. Our declining profits have become a serious issue at headquarters...
Apparently headquarters sent in an undercover inspector a while back, and... *sigh*...
Ah.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hey, do you think that older man from the other day could be...？
Definitely...
Ooh, teach!
Teacher？
What's an 'inspection'？ I don't really get it~
Basically... corporate had someone pretend to be a customer to spy on us.
So... how did they evaluate us？
It was terrible... First off, they said employee morale was in the gutter...
By employees, do you mean...
Is it... our fault？
Well, my own rating was rock bottom too... It's not like I don't wanna try, you know? And yet... this is so harsh...
(Good grief, this guy...)
If we do end up closing down, some of you part-timers... might be able to transfer to a nearby branch.
'Some of us'...？ Does that mean not everyone？
Pretty much... 'Select capable staff,' they said.
No way! Then Mayu and Nocchi don't stand a chance!
Wait, me too？
A-anyway, that's how it is! That's all for today!
Aww, Boss, what are we supposed to do then~？
Hey... what should we do？
Why not just work at Aisha？ It'd suck having to learn a whole new job anyway.
True... It'd probably be pretty much the same kind of work.
Hey, you got a moment？
Anegasaki
What do you plan to do？
● might not even make the cut, honestly. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ definitely will, though.
Hmm...
It'd be great if ● made the cut too, so we could go to the same store together.
Eh？
I really wouldn't want us to be separated.
Yeah... I don't want to be apart either...
I'm glad... that you feel that way too...
Well, of course I do.
Still, it's sad to think we won't be able to work at a place full of memories.
If only the restaurant didn't have to close down...
Okay...
(Isn't there anything we can do...？)
(Alright, time to get to work today too!)
(Not many customers today either...)
Anegasaki
Welcome.
Ah...
...Hmm？
Manager Yarisawa...
Yarisawa
Hello there. Good day.
From Aisha...!
Um, how can I help you today？
Don't be so on guard. I only came to have a meal as a customer today, you know？
A customer？
Would you show me to a table？
Oh, forgive me. Right this way, please.
(She's definitely scoping out the place. Came to size us up, huh...)
Excuse me, ma'am. Would you care for a refill on your water？
Yes, please.
Excuse me.
...Have you been working here long？
...Well, for a while now. Please take your time—
Interested in working at my place？
Eh！？
Hehe, just kidding. Though...
I really would like her, though... Miss Anegasaki, I mean. Just kidding？ That was a joke too, you know. Hehe.
(Man, she rubs me the wrong way...)
▲主人公＊▲。
Were you talking to Manager Yarizawa about something？
She asked if I wanted to work at her place.
Eh？
She said it was a joke. Pretty mean-spirited, right？
I see... Yeah, that really is in bad taste.
(Poaching staff... No way, right？)
(Alright, time for another day of work!)
Manager
Oh, there you are. Hey!
Oh, Boss. What's up？
I need to talk to you today... later on.
...Got it.
My stomach...
(Could it be...？)
'Sup...
Komari
'Sup!
Otori
Mayu, read the room...
Hah...
(Ugh, so gloomy...)
Is this everyone？
Anegasaki
Yes, everyone's here.
Right, okay... Well then.
...As feared, it's official. The store is closing down... *sigh*
Komari & Otori
Whaaat?!
I wanted to fight for it too, but it's corporate's call, you know？ A lot went into it... Not like we're closing tomorrow or anything.
Around when will it be？
Who knows, a month from now, maybe six months...
You don't even know？
Look, like I said, there's a lot going on. Anyway, good work!
Guess it really is time for Aisha, then.
Hmm, wanna go buy resumes？
This... I just can't accept this...
(Alright, time for work! Not that there are any customers, though...)
Manager
Oh, there you are. Hey, c'mere a sec!
Boss... Yes, what is it？
So, about that shortlist for the top-performing staff...
Yes.
Well... you didn't make the cut.
I see...
At least you're just a student working part-time! If I lose my job in this economy, I'm... *sigh*... Well, do your best until we close, okay？
(Didn't make the cut, huh... Well, with only ●, I guess it makes sense...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。
What's wrong？ Looking a little down there.
Yeah, that transfer selection... I didn't make it.
Sorry... If ● got chosen, we could've kept working together at Dixie's... Wait, what about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You made it, right？
Yeah, that's what they said. Said if I want to, I can work at the Towano branch.
Figures! It's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, of course they'd want you!
...I'm sorry. Just me, huh.
I should be sorry... I'll have to find another job nearby where we can work together.
Eh？
Neither of us wants to be separated, right？
...Y-yeah. If we want to work together again... we'll have to find something outside of Dixie's.
Yeah, I'll look around.
(Gotta think of something!)
(Alright, time for work!)
(Even if I'll have to quit before long, though...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Come on, you can't be making such a gloomy face in front of the customers.
Yeah, sorry... You're right.
Mm-hmm... At least put on a cheerful face for the customers, okay？
Man, I'm beat. And it wasn't even busy...
Otori
Oh, someone's already here.
Komari
Ahaha, look, the reject club!
Yo. What's that supposed to mean, 'reject club'？
The transfer picks! None of us three made it, so we're the Reject Trio~
I really thought I had a shot, though...
Clumsy as you are, Nocchi？ No way in heck~
Um... why？ Wait... why wouldn't I be able to？
More importantly, what're you two gonna do？ Nene-san made the cut, didn't she？
Yeah... Hate to make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ deal with it, but I guess we'll just find another job together.
Makes sense. Working at the same place is special, so who'd wanna be split up, right~？
Huh？ But the manager said Anegasaki-san was going to the Towano branch.
And that she'd be shift lead right off the bat, too... Huh, did I get that mixed up？
What's wrong？
O-oh, it's nothing. ●, my break's almost over, so I'm heading back. See ya.
See ya~
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Did you take the transfer offer？)
(I need to ask ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ about going to Towano properly...)
Anegasaki
...Hmm？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。
What is it？
About that Dixie's transfer...
...Yeah.
Is it true you're going to the Towano branch？
Yes...
But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you said you hated the idea of not working together...
Of course I do...
Then why？
Well... Being a shift lead would be really rewarding. Plus, when people trust me with responsibility, I want to take it seriously.
Even so, you didn't have to decide without telling me...
...I'm sorry. I thought about it a lot, but... I just felt like I couldn't explain it...
I'm sorry. I hate not being able to work together, too... That part really is true, okay？
Yeah, you're right... It really just comes down to wishing ● could've made the cut too.
No, I should have been honest about what I was thinking the whole time...
I see... It's something ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ thought through and decided on, right？
Yeah.
Then it's okay. It'd be pathetic of me to keep acting so selfish about it.
It's all right. Besides...
It actually made me happy that you were being selfish. That you didn't want us working apart.
Because I want us to feel the same way about that. Because that part really is true.
(● needs to grow up...)
(All right, time to get to work today!)
(...I wonder how many shifts we have left here...)
Manager
Ah, good timing! Hey, hey.
What's up, Boss？
Hey, uh... how do I place an order in this case again？
Huh？ Even if you ask ●, I've got no idea...
Eeeh？ Guess you're no help... Oh, there she is! Nene-kuun!
Anegasaki
All right~
What's wrong？
Take a look at this, I'm getting some kind of error.
Ah, this isn't a new entry, you have to process it as an addition...
Hm？ Oh, right, right! Hahaha, I totally forgot!
Geez, get it together, Boss.
Sorry, sorry! Man, you saved me! Thanks a bunch, Nene-kun!
You're welcome. Well, I'll get back to it.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is indispensable to this place...)
Man, though... We'd be totally helpless without Nene-kun!
(This guy, seriously...)
Going on break...
Having nothing to do is tiring in its own way... *sigh*
Nice work.
Good work. ...Sorry.
Why？
Well... I've just been kind of slacking off.
What's this？ Why so serious all of a sudden？
Seeing how you handled the boss, I realized how much everyone really relies on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Oh, that's just because the boss never remembers, no matter how long it's been...
Still, that's what being competent is. No wonder you made the cut.
Sorry... That kind of sounded like whining, didn't it？
No... I should probably get back now.
(Sigh... Why does it always have to end up like this...？)
(All right, time to pick up some groceries and head home...)
(Cup noodles, bread... Did I still have milk？)
Clerk
Welcome! Would you like some fresh side dishes today？
(Huh, homemade side dishes...)
Come take a look! Anything catch your eye？
(Something like this might be nice for a change...)
Are you a student living alone？ Getting enough homemade food？
Huh？ Yeah, well... More or less.
Hehe, convenience store meals are fine and all, but you need home cooking too! We ladies make all of ours fresh daily.
Oh, really...？ Ooh, that mackerel looks good.
Doesn't it？ It's our special today! If you get the miso mackerel, how about some spinach and bean sprout namul to keep things balanced？
Makes sense. Sounds good!
And if it were me, I'd say— Oh, Nene-chan.
Nene-chan, got it. ...Wait, Nene-chan？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...No way, what？ Why are the two of you together？
Wait, even if you ask why—
Oh my gosh, wait, huh？ Could it be... wait, really？ Him？
Yeah... Ugh, give me a break~.
Let me introduce you. This is my mom.
Mrs. Anegasaki
Thank you for taking care of my Nene-chan. ...Thought I was her older sister, didn't you？
Jeez, don't say weird things like that.
Haha... Um, my name is ●, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲.
I hear all about you from Nene- chan. So there's no need to be so stiff, okay？
Yes...
Fufu... But you're cuter than I expected. The way Nene-chan brags about you, I pictured more of a dashing pretty boy.
S-Sorry about that...
Mom, seriously~... You're putting him on the spot!
Oh, you're not troubled at all, right~？
Haha...
Come on, Mom, back to work! Aren't you on the clock？
Oops, that's right! Here, this one's on the house. Take it with you.
Are you sure？
Go ahead. It's nothing fancy, just a small token to mark our getting acquainted.
Thank you so much, I'll gladly take it.
Alright, that's enough! Let's get going, okay？
Fufu, see you later! Come visit our house next time, okay？ And tell me whose cooking tasted better—mine or Nene-chan's？
Mom, seriously! Come on, let's go.
Y-Yeah. Well, thank you very much! Goodbye!
Anegasaki
Haaah... That really caught me off guard.
● too... But I don't think I've ever seen ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ so flustered before.
Oh, hush. But... thinking about it, it's the local supermarket, so it's almost weird we haven't run into her until now.
True. But your mom didn't even ask my name, so how did she know right away that ● was...
...was my boyfriend, you mean？
Yep.
Well... we are mother and daughter, after all. She was bound to find out.
Plus, it's just the two of us women at home, so I guess we talk about that stuff a lot more than most families do...
I see... You two are really close, huh？
I guess？ Even though she's my mom, we really are kind of like sisters sometimes.
...Hmm？
Come to think of it, didn't you say your mom was a housewife？
Ah... oh... Yeah, did I say something like that？
Um... Can we talk for a bit...？
Anegasaki
It's already gotten dark... Sorry.
No, it's fine, but...
What did you want to talk about？
Yeah... About what you said about my mom earlier...
You see... right now, it's just my mom and me living together.
Just the two of you？ Does that mean your dad is—
I have a dad, too. It's just, he gets transferred around for work so much that he barely visits a few times a year.
I had no idea.
Yeah. And whenever I tell people that I live with just my mom and work part-time, they always say the same thing.
'That must be tough,' or 'You're so admirable'...
Sure, living apart from my dad gets lonely, and we're definitely not rich... but everyone's healthy and we get along, so... we're plenty happy as we are.
I wasn't sure if I could explain that properly, so I just... kept it to myself. I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it. You're telling me now. And I really do understand.
Thank you...
And, well... There's something I want to study in college, so I've been saving up for it with my part-time job.
Someday, I want to open a small restaurant with my mom... So I want to study accounting properly for that.
This is the first time I've told you this, isn't it？
Yeah, first time I've heard it. A restaurant, huh...

It really doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just a few seats, you know？ But the kind of place where regulars always gather... Besides, there's still so much undecided right now, like where I'll go to school, right？
I see... You've really thought all this through, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah. So, you see... About the selection, too...
I've been working at Dixie's for a while, so the pay is good. And if I become shift leader, my hourly wage goes up, plus it'll be good practice for the future.
Yeah...
That's why I don't want to switch to a different part-time job.
Is that how it was... I'm sorry, ●...
I'm the one who didn't say anything. You didn't do anything wrong.
And besides...
Even if it's just a high school part-time job, you do your best to make people happy. Mom told me that's what taking your work seriously means.
When I started high school and told her I wanted to get a job, that's what she asked me. 'Can you do that？'
So when they told me about the shift leader position, I was honestly so happy.
Because it felt like taking my work seriously had actually been recognized.
(Taking it seriously, huh...)
So right now...
I really want to keep working at Dixie's.
(I get it now... So that's why ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ works at Dixie's.)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
...Hmm？
About those selections for Dixie's...
Ah... yeah. What is it？
● want to try pushing myself harder.
Eh？
You said you wanted us to work together, so it'd be pathetic if we couldn't just because of ●. But there's no way I want to get in the way of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s goals, either.
I'm really happy, but... are you pushing yourself too hard？
Even if it is, ● want to do this. I'll ask the manager. If he says no... I'll still give it everything I've got right to the end.
▲主人公＊▲。
● want to take this seriously too, just like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Thank you...
(Alright, time to get to work today!)
Manager
Hah...
Ah, Manager!
Yeah, what is it？
There's something I'd like to talk to you about. Do you have a minute later？
Talk？ Ah, sure, as long as it doesn't take long.
Thank you! Excuse me, then!
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm gonna ask the manager about the transfer today.
Okay, got it. I'll ask along with you.
(All right!)
Hm, Nene's with you too？
Yes. Sorry to take up your time.
Yeah. So what is it？ I'm pretty busy, so...
Right. It's about the selection... Is there any way ● could work at the Towano store too？
Huh？ But that's already been decided... That kind of puts me in a spot.
Please, there must be something you can do!
Mmm...
The closing date hasn't been set yet, right？ So wouldn't it be okay？
As far as the timing goes, sure. But there are actual selection criteria for that. If I recall... length of service, and performance.
Besides, with high school students it's tough... Nene's pretty much the only exception.
She's a pretty special case, though. Honestly, I've been asking her to do work way beyond a part-timer.
Then... for example, if I can work as well as Anegasaki-san, could ● be chosen too？
Well, I suppose you could say that, but...
Please!
Please, from me too!
Hmm, well, I'll ask, just in case... But you？
I'll do my best!
I-Is that so... Well, do your best, then.
Okay！
Looks like it might work out, maybe？
Yeah, I'm gonna give it my all. So, um, I have a favor to ask.
What？
Could you teach me the ropes？ I know I'm relying on you right away, but...
Not at all. It makes me so happy that you're relying on me. I wanted to help too. After all... it's for the two of us.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Hehe! But knowing how the manager is, unless you tackle the hard tasks and really show him, he'll just sweep it under the rug.
Y-Yeah, I guess you're right...
Hey, pull yourself together! Starting today, Miss Nene's gonna be strict, okay？ Got it？
All right!
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
...Hmm？
There's some stuff about work I'd like to study, so I was hoping you could teach me.
Hmm. In that case... want to come over to my place？
To ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s place？
Yeah. I have a staff manual at home, too. Plus my own notebook with tips I jotted down.
That's awesome! Now it really feels like special training.
That's right. This is special training! Come on, double time!
Eh！？
Anegasaki
All right, come on in.
Thanks for having me~
Mrs. Anegasaki
Oh, welcome!
Ah, hello. Thanks for having me.
Mom, don't you have work？
Oh, didn't I tell you？ Today's inventory day, so the supermarket is closed.
Oh, right...
Oh dear, am I in the way？ Should I go out for a bit？
Don't say weird things like that.
Just kidding! So, can Mom join the conversation too？
Well...
No. We're studying today, so please don't interrupt.
My, how diligent... Well, after you finish, okay？
Jeez, you're hopeless.
All right, let's get started.
Yeah. I wanted to ask about the special register codes, and ordering, processing slips... Is there anything else you do, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Let's see... supply management, making the part-timer shifts... Oh, and answering the phones.
I see... Sounds like there's a lot to cover.
...So, what do you think？ Want to back out？
No way! Please teach me!
